prime_source: Fed H.15 bank prime loan rate (RIFSPBLP_N.B), observed through 2026-10-02
spread_base: prime in effect on the first business day of the approval month (13 CFR 120.214(c))
source: SBA FOIA 7(a) as of 2026-06-30, change-of-ownership variable-rate term loans approved FY2025-26 (Oct 2024 - Jun 2026), including 770 cancelled and 999 approved but not yet disbursed: median of initial rate minus the prime in effect on the first business day of the approval month (Fed H.15; the base SBA rules peg variable 7(a) rates to, 13 CFR 120.214(c)), by ln(loan), made non-increasing. Knot uncertainty 0.05-0.19 pp (the largest of the bootstrap SE, the range across samples - disbursed only, FY2025 only, FY2026 only, FY2018-26 - and 0.05 pp, because rates heap at quarter points)
